evidence.evidence_text: To address the limitation, we propose RelAdapter, a context-aware adapter for few-shot relation learning in KGs designed to enhance the adaptation process in meta-learning.
To predict instances for novel relations with limited training examples, few-shot relation learning approaches have emerged, utilizing techniques such as meta-learning.
Extensive experiments on three benchmark KGs validate the superiority of RelAdapter over state-of-the-art methods.
